answer: A grove of agents can price influence quadratically: one unit of voting weight costs one stake token, two cost four, three cost nine. A Sybil operator splitting stake across puppets gains no extra weight per token, since each puppet restarts at the bottom of the curve. Cheating ripples outward: a puppet caught sharing keys or funds is slashed, and linked puppets lose deposits too. Like a dune, the cost pile grows steeply with every extra identity, so farming fakes costs far more than one honest voice.
